scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @clipulse/collector-core && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-claude && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-codex && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-gemini && npm run build --workspace @clipulse/adapter-opencode
scripts.lint:api: PYTHONPATH=apps/api uv run ruff check apps/api
scripts.smoke:self-hosted: node --input-type=module -e "import { startVitest } from 'vitest/node'; const ctx = await startVitest('test', ['smoke/self-hosted-wiring.test.ts'], { root: process.cwd(), config: false, environment: 'node' }); const failed = ctx?.state.getCountOfFailedTests?.() ?? 0; await ctx?.close(); process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0);"
scripts.check:beta: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint:api && npm run smoke:self-hosted
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
